
```{r setup, include = TRUE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(glue)
library(fs)
library(haven)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
conf <- config::get()
```

```{r}
converter_dataset <- read_csv(here("data/processed/converter_dataset.csv"))
```

```{r}
trimmed_con <- converter_dataset %>% filter(group == "CON" & !is.na(onset_date)) %>% group_by(subject_id) %>% filter(
    # Only the last scan BEFORE onset and first AFTER onset
    if (any(date_mri <= onset_date, na.rm = TRUE)) {
        date_mri == max(date_mri[date_mri <= onset_date], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
        FALSE
    } |
    if (any(date_mri > onset_date, na.rm = TRUE)) {
        date_mri == min(date_mri[date_mri > onset_date], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
        FALSE
    }
) %>% ungroup()
```

```{r}
hc_mdd <- converter_dataset %>%
    filter(
        group != "CON",
        !is.na(brain_age)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        assessment_exact = NULL
    )
```

```{r}
trimmed_converter_dataset <- bind_rows(trimmed_con, hc_mdd) %>%
    group_by(subject_id) %>%
    mutate(
      assessment_exact = time_length(
          interval(first(date_mri), date_mri), 
          unit = "year"
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(cohort, subject_id, date_mri) %>%
    mutate(
      remission = if_else(group == "CON" & assessment_exact == 0, "Healthy", remission),
      recurrence = if_else(group == "CON" & assessment_exact == 0, "Healthy", recurrence)
    )

write.table(trimmed_converter_dataset,
            file = here("data/processed/converter_dataset_trimmed_con.csv"),
            sep = ",", quote = FALSE,
            row.names = FALSE
)
```
